summary.text: Jill Douglass is the Republican candidate for Nevada State Assembly District 37 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Shea Backus.
A financial executive by career, she is a news columnist and host of the Douglass Dialogue radio show, according to her Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Douglass was born at Eglin Air Force Base in Florida and earned a high school diploma from Niceville High School, an associate degree from Northwest Florida State College and a degree from the American College.
Her career experience includes working as a financial executive.
In her 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she has called the district home for 32 years, built a business and raised four sons.
Douglass won the June 11, 2024 Republican primary for Nevada State Senate District 6 over Joshua Stacy and lost the general election to incumbent Democrat Nicole Cannizzaro.
In her 2026 survey, she said she signed the No New Taxes Pledge, and she listed affordability, public safety and strengthening education outcomes as her key messages.
